description: This Java class defines the 'FormResource' entity in the OpenMRS system, representing key-value pairs linked to a form, with various metadata such as datatype, handler configurations, and change tracking details.

classes.name: FormResource
classes.description: Represents a form resource associated with a form in OpenMRS, functioning as a key-value pair with datatype and handler configurations, including metadata for audit and cache management.
